newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dlr closes firmer, seen in US$0.6990-7010 range.
newsitem.headline: NZ dlr closes firmer, seen in US$0.6990-7010 range.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar closed slightly firmer on Wednesday but dealers said the currency was stuck in a US$0.6990-7010 range which it was unlikely to shake in the near term.
The Kiwi closed at US$0.6998/05 and at 66.78 on its Trade-Weighted Index, a touch above its 0.6991/98 and 66.73 local open.
"We've seen some buying from mid morning up to a high of 0.7004, but from there we're just drifting down as the Aussie is drifting down," said one chief dealer.

He said the lack of any rate cuts across the Tasman had dampened hopes of a lower Australian unit for the time being, which had kept the Kiwi well supported, "but I think the Kiwi still looks stuck in a range," he said.
Dealers said the lack of any upside progress was starting to frustrate people and the chances were that the Kiwi could drift lower.
Rumours of a large samurai issue were still circulating the market, but there were no firm reports as yet.
Dealer saw the Kiwi remaining within a 0.6990-7010 range overnight. -- Matthew Brockett 64 4 4714 272
